name: Recall Memory
description: Render the user's memory as a bare numbered list ('1. ...\n2. ...', or nothing when empty). The numbers are the handles the agent uses with memory_update and memory_forget. Reference this from an agent's config.context (with a `label` on that entry, e.g. 'User memory') so the list is always present as a '[Context: <label>]' system block.

path.description: Workspace path of the memory list (default 'w/memory').

output.description: A bare numbered text block of memory items, or null when the list is empty. The heading/label is supplied by the config.context entry, not this op.
